regime_context: China A-shares show an extremely narrow leadership structure: only 4 of 22 themes are trend-eligible, with Banks dominant (crowded, mixed Hurst) and Coal a distant challenger. The absolute-trend gate explicitly did_NOT_hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), so the one validated drawdown-control edge is absent here — this note must lean very low and treat all direction as conditional judgement, not edge.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's rotation margin to Banks (currently 0.158 and narrowing) sustains over the next 10 sessions. If Coal's relative score closes half the gap and remains uncrowded while Banks stays at crowding_z above 1.5, that would be a confirmed leadership handoff — retire this watch if the margin widens back above 0.20 by mid-October.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme with both high momentum rank (0.918) and the strongest durability bar (0.64) plus broad participation (breadth 0.722). The trend gate shows eligible=true, but crowding_z=1.6 flags crowded conditions. The detector supports continuation in leadership, not return forecasting; the lean is a conditional stay-with-the-tape view, not an alpha claim.
theses.dissent: Crowding at 1.6 sigma with mixed Hurst tag suggests the move may already be mature; on a mean-reverting tape (gate_helps=false), broad-but-crowded leadership is historically where drawdowns concentrate.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS loses more than 4% relative to CSI 300 before 2026-10-18

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only uncrowded eligible theme (crowding_z=0.6, crowded=false) with real momentum (score 0.76) and a respectable durability bar (0.49). Its mean-revert Hurst tag cautions against extrapolating too far, but the rotation margin to Banks (0.158) is narrowing and absorption is low (0.33), so a secondary non-crowded cyclicals lean is defensible as conditional rotation support.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag plus low breadth (0.4) means Coal leadership could fade quickly; if banks re-assert, coal's relative edge disappears without warning.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS underperforms CSI 300 by more than 3% through 2026-10-13

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma sits at rank 3 but is crowded (crowding_z=1.44) with a modest durability bar (0.51) and weak breadth (0.429). The detector's crowding flag is a size-down caution, not a short, but combined with no clear rotation signal and a mean-reverting market regime, a fresh overweight has poor conditional odds.
theses.dissent: If Banks rolls over on crowding, Pharma as the next crowded-but-eligible healthcare name could absorb flow — avoiding it risks missing a confirmed handoff.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms Banks by over 5% relative before 2026-10-18

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
